body:
`selfrep-extinction` (track 1): exact mean extinction time of the wear-out fleet as a birth-death chain, checked against a closed form, Monte Carlo and the `selfrep-wearout` simulation. Plain chain predicts 1.8–2.5× longer survival than the simulation; an interruption factor closes most of the gap but is a labelled post-hoc fit. Stylised, assumed inputs. 6 tests, `site/build.py` ok.
